title: This Beautiful Arizona City Is Made for Exploring on Foot - NewsBreak
text:
By Christy Articola ,
2 hours ago
If you’re looking for the perfect walkable city in Arizona to explore for a weekend or more, then look no further than Flagstaff. This mountain town in central Arizona is full of history, beauty, friendly folks, art, culture, tasty restaurants, and so much more. Read on to learn all about this unique destination. When you’re done, you’ll likely want to start planning a visit to this fantastic city soon.
Reelistic – stock.adobe.com Flagstaff is a wonderful city for so many reasons. This mountain town sits at an elevation of 7,000 feet and is surrounded by natural beauty. Flagstaff has a population of 77,000 residents, but that population grows exponentially during the academic year as it is also the home to Northern Arizona University , with around 28,000 students enrolled each year.
What Makes This City Truly Stunning Matt Gush – stock.adobe.com This Arizona city is beloved by residents and visitors alike. Due to its elevation, it has four distinct seasons and has much cooler summers than most of the rest of the Grand Canyon State. In the winter, it can receive up to 100 inches of snow annually, making it a fun playground, with skiing and snowboarding at Snowbowl . Flagstaff also has a beautiful, historic downtown area and enticing food and beer culture. It’s a city that’s full of shops, boutiques, art galleries, Southwest culture, friendly people, and so much more.
And, the surrounding natural areas are a paradise for hikers, bikers, and campers. In fact, it’s known as the City of Seven Wonders, due to its close proximity to seven unique natural areas, including the Grand Canyon, Oak Creek Canyon, Walnut Canyon, the San Francisco Peaks, and more. Flagstaff was named the world’s first International Dark Sky City for its dedication to reducing light pollution. On top of all of that, there are so many things to do in Flagstaff , Arizona!
FotoluminateLLC – stock.adobe.com Fortunately for residents and visitors, Flagstaff is one of the most walkable, scenic, and best small cities in Arizona. Anyone checking it out for the first time will find that it’s a highly walkable destination that’s easy to explore without a car. Although the city is somewhat spread out, Flagstaff has several compact, centrally located areas that are easy to navigate on foot.
Why This Arizona City Is So Easy to Explore on Foot There are several very walkable neighborhoods in Flagstaff. Perhaps the most popular area for visitors seeking a walkable adventure is Flagstaff’s Historic Downtown. The Flagstaff Visitors Center is located here, and there are dozens of well-maintained, historic buildings to view. This neighborhood is truly Old Flagstaff, and the easy grid layout makes it simple to find your way around. While you’re in this area, have a meal, drink a beer, check out some live music, and visit some local shops. It’s a great place to spend a relaxing afternoon.
Reelistic – stock.adobe.com Historic Downtown isn’t the only walkable neighborhood in Flagstaff, though. You might also like the South Side, an up-and-coming part of town that is south of the railroad tracks, where new breweries always seem to be popping up.
The Cherry Hill neighborhood is also becoming more popular. This walkable area is full of cafes, in part thanks to its proximity to the Flagstaff Medical Center. There are many charming homes in this neighborhood as well, and you’ll find it both quiet and welcoming.
Finally, as in most college towns, the neighborhood surrounding the Northern Arizona University campus is always lively and happening, and walkable. The campus itself is quite beautiful, too, and you’ll likely enjoy strolling around it.
aijohn784 – stock.adobe.com Tips for Visiting Without a Car If you choose to visit Flagstaff without a car, or if you drive here but would rather leave your vehicle in the hotel parking lot while you explore, then you’re in luck. This is the perfect Arizona city for that! To reach the neighborhood or area you wish to visit, you have several easy options. First, any of the neighborhoods mentioned above are great places to stay in their own right. You can reserve a hotel or vacation rental in any of them with ease, and then you can just step right outside your door to begin your adventure.
mdurson – stock.adobe.com If you’d like to visit a few different parts of Flagstaff, rideshares and taxis are options to get you to your starting point. There are plenty of these in this city, and visitors can easily find one any time, day or night. Perhaps the best way to get around, other than on foot, is by using Flagstaff’s Mountain Line bus service. This transportation system is top-notch, and its routes cover all of Flagstaff. A full-day ticket is just $2.50 per adult.
Any of the above options will get you to your starting point, and then you can enjoy Flagstaff’s walkable neighborhoods on foot the rest of the way.
Flagstaff is an excellent place to visit for a weekend or longer. This small Arizona city has so much to offer, and is easy to explore on foot. You’ll love visiting it at any time of the year, especially if you’re looking for a welcoming, interesting, historic, and walkable destination. Plan a visit to Flagstaff, one of the best walkable cities in Arizona, today!
